prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pearland, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1396; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the parking lot collision you were involved in in Pearland. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please tell me in your own words what happened.

A: I was backing out of a parking space at the shopping center. My car was moving slowly, maybe a few miles an hour. I checked my mirrors but a van coming down the aisle was partly hidden by a pillar. We made contact on the rear quarter panel of my car.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt at the time?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you hit your head or feel any injury right after the impact?

A: I hit my head on the window frame. At first I just felt dizzy and had a ringing in my ears. I sat in the car for a while before I got out.

Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that evening. They said I had a concussion. I've had headaches, trouble concentrating, and I've been sensitive to light since then.

Q: Are you still under medical care for those symptoms?

A: Yes, I have a follow-up scheduled with my doctor and I've been told to limit screen time and rest as much as possible.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I've had to take time off work, and I'm still not back to normal.

Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
